relationships.name: nonzero status
relationships.description: The destination path for the FlowFile created from the command's output, if the returned status code is non-zero. All FlowFiles routed to this relationship will be penalized.

relationships.name: original
relationships.description: The original FlowFile will be routed. It will have new attributes detailing the result of the script execution.

relationships.name: output stream
relationships.description: The destination path for the FlowFile created from the command's output, if the returned status code is zero.

Working Directory.name: Working Directory
Working Directory.description: The directory to use as the current working directory when executing the command

Command Path.name: Command Path
Command Path.description: Specifies the command to be executed; if just the name of an executable is provided, it must be in the user's environment PATH.

Command Arguments Strategy.name: Command Arguments Strategy
Command Arguments Strategy.description: Strategy for configuring arguments to be supplied to the command.

allowableValue.description: Arguments to be supplied to the executable are taken from the Command Arguments property
Arguments to be supplied to the executable are taken from dynamic properties with pattern of 'command.argument.<commandIndex>'

Command Arguments.name: Command Arguments
Command Arguments.description: The arguments to supply to the executable delimited by the ';' character.

Argument Delimiter.name: Argument Delimiter
Argument Delimiter.description: Delimiter to use to separate arguments for a command [default: ;]. Must be a single character

Ignore STDIN.name: Ignore STDIN
Ignore STDIN.description: If true, the contents of the incoming FlowFile will not be passed to the executing command

Output Destination Attribute.name: Output Destination Attribute
Output Destination Attribute.description: If set, the output of the stream command will be put into an attribute of the original FlowFile instead of a separate FlowFile. There will no longer be a relationship for 'output stream' or 'nonzero status'. The value of this property will be the key for the output attribute.

Max Attribute Length.name: Max Attribute Length
Max Attribute Length.description: If routing the output of the stream command to an attribute, the number of characters put to the attribute value will be at most this amount. This is important because attributes are held in memory and large attributes will quickly cause out of memory issues. If the output goes longer than this value, it will truncated to fit. Consider making this smaller if able.

Output MIME Type.name: Output MIME Type
Output MIME Type.description: Specifies the value to set for the "mime.type" attribute. This property is ignored if 'Output Destination Attribute' is set.

PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE.name: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE.description: Sets the environment variable 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE' for the process' environment

PYTHONUNBUFFERED.name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
PYTHONUNBUFFERED.description: Sets the environment variable 'PYTHONUNBUFFERED' for the process' environment

TEMP.name: TEMP
TEMP.description: Sets the environment variable 'TEMP' for the process' environment

TMP.name: TMP
TMP.description: Sets the environment variable 'TMP' for the process' environment

TMPDIR.name: TMPDIR
TMPDIR.description: Sets the environment variable 'TMPDIR' for the process' environment

relationships.name: failure
relationships.description: Files that could not be written to the output directory for some reason are transferred to this relationship

relationships.name: success
relationships.description: Files that have been successfully written to the output directory are transferred to this relationship

Directory.name: Directory
Directory.description: The directory to which files should be written. You may use expression language such as /aa/bb/${path}

Conflict Resolution Strategy.name: Conflict Resolution Strategy
Conflict Resolution Strategy.description: Indicates what should happen when a file with the same name already exists in the output directory

Create Missing Directories.name: Create Missing Directories
Create Missing Directories.description: If true, then missing destination directories will be created. If false, FlowFiles are penalized and sent to failure.

Maximum File Count.name: Maximum File Count
Maximum File Count.description: Specifies the maximum number of files that can exist in the output directory

Last Modified Time.name: Last Modified Time
Last Modified Time.description: Sets the lastModifiedTime on the output file to the value of this attribute.  Format must be yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ.  You may also use expression language such as ${file.lastModifiedTime}.

Permissions.name: Permissions
Permissions.description: Sets the permissions on the output file to the value of this attribute.  Format must be either UNIX rwxrwxrwx with a - in place of denied permissions (e.g. rw-r--r--) or an octal number (e.g. 644).  You may also use expression language such as ${file.permissions}.

Owner.name: Owner
Owner.description: Sets the owner on the output file to the value of this attribute.  You may also use expression language such as ${file.owner}. Note on many operating systems Nifi must be running as a super-user to have the permissions to set the file owner.

Group.name: Group
Group.description: Sets the group on the output file to the value of this attribute.  You may also use expression language such as ${file.group}.

Resource Transfer Source.name: Resource Transfer Source
Resource Transfer Source.description: The source of the content to be transferred

allowableValue.description: The content of the incoming FlowFile provides the source for transfer
The File Resource Service provides the source for transfer

File Resource Service.name: File Resource Service
File Resource Service.description: File Resource Service providing access to the local resource to be transferred

File Size.name: File Size
File Size.description: The size of the file that will be used
File Size.expressionLanguageScope: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The number of FlowFiles to be transferred in each invocation

Data Format.name: Data Format
Data Format.description: Specifies whether the data should be Text or Binary

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles
Unique FlowFiles.description: If true, each FlowFile that is generated will be unique. If false, all generated FlowFiles will have the same content. When Unique FlowFiles is false, the first FlowFile in a batch is written and additional FlowFiles clone that content.

Custom Text.name: Custom Text
Custom Text.description: If Data Format is text and if Unique FlowFiles is false, then this custom text will be used as content of the generated FlowFiles and the File Size will be ignored. Finally, if Expression Language is used, evaluation will be performed only once per batch of generated FlowFiles
Custom Text.expressionLanguageScope: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: Specifies the character set to use when writing the bytes of Custom Text to a FlowFile.

Mime Type.name: Mime Type
Mime Type.description: Specifies the value to set for the "mime.type" attribute.

relationships.name: failure
relationships.description: Failed to convert attributes to JSON

Attributes List.name: Attributes List
Attributes List.description: Comma separated list of attributes to be included in the resulting JSON. If this value is left empty then all existing Attributes will be included. This list of attributes is case sensitive. If an attribute specified in the list is not found it will be be emitted to the resulting JSON with an empty string or NULL value.

Attributes Regular Expression.name: Attributes Regular Expression
Attributes Regular Expression.description: Regular expression that will be evaluated against the flow file attributes to select the matching attributes. This property can be used in combination with the attributes list property.
Attributes Regular Expression.expressionLanguageScope: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties

Destination.name: Destination
Destination.description: Control if JSON value is written as a new FlowFile attribute 'JSONAttributes' or written in the FlowFile content. Writing to FlowFile content will overwrite any existing FlowFile content.

Include Core Attributes.name: Include Core Attributes
Include Core Attributes.description: Determines if the FlowFile org.apache.nifi.flowfile.attributes.CoreAttributes which are contained in every FlowFile should be included in the final JSON value generated.

Null Value.name: Null Value
Null Value.description: If true a non existing selected attribute will be NULL in the resulting JSON. If false an empty string will be placed in the JSON

JSON Handling Strategy.name: JSON Handling Strategy
JSON Handling Strategy.description: Strategy to use for handling attributes which contain nested JSON.

allowableValue.description: Escapes JSON attribute values to strings
Handles JSON attribute values as nested structured objects or arrays

Pretty Print.name: Pretty Print
Pretty Print.description: Apply pretty print formatting to the output.
